intro: Down in the cellar of Thunderbrew Distillery, guard Jarven Thunderbrew finds himself surrounded by barrels he is forbidden to touch. Craving a taste of the family craft, he asks a passing adventurer for a mug of Thunder Ale to help sharpen his wits on duty.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!

clips.title: Completion
paras: For me? You're a true hero, friend!
